# Enclava.dev

> Confidential applications platform. Push a container, get a confidential application running inside a hardware TEE (AMD SEV-SNP). Encrypted in use, verifiable by anyone, invisible to the cloud.

A product of [Enclava Labs](https://enclava-labs.com/). Sister product: [enclava.ai](https://enclava.ai) for confidential AI.

- [Documentation](https://docs.enclava.dev)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/enclava-labs/)
- [X](https://x.com/EnclavaLabs)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/enclava-labs/)

## Product

- [Platform](/platform): Hosted PaaS and open-source CAP engine
- [Use cases](/use-cases): Private AI, regulated SaaS, encrypted databases, and more
